title: Gaussian characteristic functional
statement: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian probability measure on $\mathbb R$, and let $L:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be a continuous real-linear functional. Its characteristic functional at $L$ is $\exp\!\left(-((L(1))^2)/2\right)$, viewed as a complex number.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a continuous real-linear functional on $\mathbb R$
